text:
maria_ops: Quick heads up — vendor 'HyperLane' emailed: projected lead times 6–8 weeks for H100s starting Oct. Peak season overlap. We need buffer strategy for MW DC (ORD). PO: PO-88912. Thoughts? :warning:

devon_procure: Ugh. Can we push next tranche earlier? Suggest reserving +25% on the upcoming PO or split into two POs to give us staggered arrivals.

liam_sc: Agree on stagger. Also propose a 'hedge' PO with right-to-return within 30 days (restocking). Ask vendor for prepaid RMA labels for DOA units during peak. That reduces runway risk.

olivia_logistics: If we add returns allowance we need clear RMA SLA. Vendor must commit to 3-business-day RT-replace or air-expedite cost share. Can we get that in writing?

hyperlane_rep: HyperLane here — can confirm 6–8 week lead time unless we commit to a surge premium. We can add prepaid RMA kit for batches > 10 units and 30-day return window on negotiated contract.

devon_procure: What's the surcharge % for surge premium?

hyperlane_rep: Surge premium 7% on unit price for air-priority, 3% for priority ground with earlier ETA. Prepaid RMA shipped as part of batch, no extra if commitment >=20 units.

liam_sc: Cost calc quick check:

```
Base unit $12,000
+7% surge => $840
Air-expedite per unit ~ $220
Net delta vs risk of outage: still cheaper than emergency buy.
```

maria_ops: Decision needed: do we (A) add 25% buffer w/ prepaid RMA and 7% surge for half order, (B) split POs w/o surge but reserve 10 hot spares on our side, or (C) keep plan and add express air top-up contingency. Vote fast.

olivia_logistics: @devon_procure can you push legal for RMA SLA clause? Also need AWB/INCOTERMS clarified (DPU vs DDP) — prefer DDP for peak.

devon_procure: Looping legal. I'll ask for DDP and RMA SLA 72h replace commitment. Also ask for sample RMA manifest. PO amendment draft incoming.

vendor_shipbot: RMA ticket created: RMA-5523 for PO-88912 batch 3 — ETA manifest in 24h. (auto)

maria_ops: Thanks — if legal ok with DDP+SLA vote: i'm +A (buffer+surge for half). :thumbsup:
